note: A1 is jumpered to DAC1 on this bench, so a capture prelude drives DAC1 (internal generator sync) and a loop prelude does not. After capture: 2 high, 3 low. After loop: 2 high, 3 low. Prior DAC1 activity does not select the mode. Note also a third level: this session shows 6, 12 and 37-38 where an earlier one showed 12 and 46, so neither the number of levels nor their values is stable between sessions.
